title: Writable locations
statement: Let $Z$ be a size specification with word width $W$, frame size $F$, dispatcher position $d$, stack capacity $Q$, and space limit $S$, satisfying its stated fit conditions and $2(F+1)\le d$. For a natural number $q$, the writable set consists of the scratch locations for $F$, the frame pointer code, the stack locations at depth $q$ with capacity $Q$, and all integer addresses $a$ with $0\le a<S$.
hypotheses_covered: $Z$ is a size specification for word width $W$
Its word, space, stack, and pool bounds satisfy the four fit inequalities
